derivation.rule: value = the agreement observed at S1, floored to 4 decimals: agreed/evaluated where the evaluations are the NWI-S1 verifier bundles of the S1 corpus (the snapshot's pinned SV-LLM/.github evidence/sv-check-receipts) joined by (repository, head commit) to ledgered admission decisions, counted by sv_e0_terminals.verdict_agreement_e0 under its own evidence rules (verifier receipts and admission decisions must both be organization-ledger receipts). S2 must not fall below S1's observed agreement. FAIL_CLOSED STAGE_THRESHOLD_BASELINE_INSUFFICIENT if the baseline is unobserved, evaluated < min_observations, or the value is vacuous (0, which every rate passes).

name: VERIFY_ONLY
thresholds_source: this manifest only; value is written solely by the declared STAGE_THRESHOLD_DERIVE transition (resident-runtime/stage_threshold_derive.py, scripts/derive_stage_thresholds.py) from threshold.derivation, never by hand; a null value is undeclared and the gate FAIL_CLOSES STAGE_THRESHOLD_UNDECLARED
